title: Power basis of a simple algebraic field extension
statement: Let $K\subseteq\Omega$ be fields [def-pc-field-extension] and $\theta\in\Omega$ algebraic over $K$ [def-weil-algebraic-element], i.e. $P(\theta)=0$ for some nonzero polynomial $P$ with coefficients in $K$. Let $K(\theta)$ be the smallest subfield of $\Omega$ containing $K$ and $\theta$. Then $K(\theta)$ is a finite extension of $K$, and if $d=[K(\theta):K]$ is its degree (its dimension as a $K$-vector space), the elements $1,\theta,\ldots,\theta^{d-1}$ form a basis of $K(\theta)$ over $K$.
